title: OmoBench model proposal v1
description: A contributor's request that one uncatalogued model be reviewed for the eligible-model catalog, submitted inside the evidence bundle of the run that used it. A proposal is a request for review and nothing else: catalog/models/*.yaml stays the only source of eligible models, and nothing here is read as one.

status.description: The only value a submitted proposal may carry. A proposal cannot describe itself as reviewed or accepted; acceptance is a separate, reviewed change to catalog/models.

proposed_id.description: The canonical model identity being proposed, in publisher/name form. It must equal the result's model.id, and it is not a serving alias.

parameter_class.description: Nominal parameter count class as the publisher states it, for example 14B or 600M.

modality.description: OmoBench v1 publishes text-generation results only; a proposal for any other modality is out of scope rather than pending.

source.description: The publisher's own page for the weights.

weights_publicly_downloadable.description: OmoBench publishes results for open weights anyone can obtain. A proposal cannot be submitted for weights that are not publicly downloadable.

proposed_by.description: The GitHub account making the proposal; bound to the result's submitter.

for_run_id.description: The run this proposal accompanies. A proposal travels with the result that used the model; it is not a standalone catalog edit.

rationale.description: Why this model belongs in the catalog, for the reviewer.
